title: Preface
summary: OCR-garbled CIA document header text (Approved For Release 2000/08/08, CIA-RDP96-00788R001700370004-1, dated 18 DEC 81) with fragments: 'ANALYST ASSUMPTION', site located in Italy within 1 1/2 hour drive from Verona, and sections labeled 'DATA ON CITY' and 'DATA ON SITE'. Mostly noise; no substantive findings beyond the location assumption and section headings.

title: SURROUNDED BY WATER, CIRCLED BY THE MOAT OR RIVER RAISED HIGHWAY ON EDGE, WITH RAMPS,
summary: The text describes a building located across the river from the Old City on a low, flat area, surrounded by water and circled by a moat or river. It sits on a raised highway at the edge, with ramps. The building is designated Building 10, south or west of the city's southwest corner, shown in a drawing. A CIA document release approval stamp (2000/08/08, CIA-RDP96-00788R) appears at the bottom.

title: 21 DEC 31
summary: A CIA-released document note (dated 21 DEC 31) describes a city's main road passing a large traffic circle with a central park. The circle faces a large cathedral, and across the street are many old stonework art forms in front of it. The target street is very narrow, almost alley-like. A 'data on site' heading follows but is left blank.

title: 20 JAN 82 DATA ON CITY:
summary: Declassified CIA document excerpt (approved for release 2000/08/08, CIA-RDP96-00788R001700370004-1) with fragmentary OCR text. Dated 20 and 26 January 1982. Records data on a city named Padua, and a subject with three men, two bearded, the subject handcuffed to a metal pipe or rail. Site data mentions a building and a 30-foot measurement. Text is largely garbled and incomplete.

title: SUMMARY
summary: The text is a declassified CIA document fragment (Approved For Release 2000/08/08, CIA-RDP96-00788R001700370004-1) with a summary table of cuing methods and response totals. Methods include name or photo in sealed envelope, photo, photo and name, and directed to return to prior target area, with dates and counts (e.g., 26, 42, 51 total responses). Two pages are exempt from release, and the rest is header and marking text only.
